profile.visual_desc: Muscular blue-furred leopard-man. He wears baggy black martial arts trousers and a long, flowing red sash tied at the waist.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Sharp feline features with intense yellow slitted eyes and a green corded headband across a blue-furred brow.
profile.weapon_desc: Twin fists channeling golden spiritual energy.
profile.step1_ready: Rear-isometric stance facing up-left. Crouched fighter pose with back to camera and fists held high.
profile.step2_windup: Twists torso right while drawing fists back, gathering bright yellow energy spheres in both palms.
profile.step3_impact: Double-palm thrust forward, releasing a large, fan-shaped golden energy blast toward the top-left.
profile.step4_finish: Holds the striking pose as the yellow energy trail dissipates before returning to a ready stance.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The golden energy cone in Frame 4 must align with the forward thrust of the palms toward the top-left.

evaluation.diagnosis: Animation expands source frames correctly. VFX timing and thrust alignment remain consistent.
